0.original: Randwulf wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Blacksmiths' Guild.

1.original: You have been referred to Brithael, forgemaster of the Blacksmiths' Guild. Seek him out and pray that you meet with his approval.

2.original: Despite knowing next to nothing about you, Forgemaster Brithael has already marked you as a promising recruit. To begin your training as a blacksmith, equip the hammer the forgemaster gave you and speak to him again.

48.original: So what'll it be? Reckon ye've got what it takes to train with the best godsdamned blacksmiths in the realm?

49.original: Hah, that's the spirit! If ye'd taken any longer to decide, I'd have told ye to bugger off no matter what ye said.

50.original: Can't have half-arsed adventurers wastin' Forgemaster Brithael's precious time, see. He's got a lot of irons in the fire. That's why me and the other lads make a point o' keepin' idlers, imbeciles, and the otherwise unqualified from gettin' in his way.

51.original: Anyroad, it's time ye went and paid yer respects to the man─he's the one over yonder makin' a face like he's carryin' the weight o' the world on his shoulders.

52.original: Gone soft on me, have ye? We need <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D656EFF046D656E03> with a will of iron, not <hex:020810E905FF066769726C73FF05626F797303> who balk at the thought o' commitment.

53.original: Still...there's always work for the willin'. Should ye find yer spine, we might consider yer membership once more. Till then, bugger off.

54.original: 'Bout time Randwulf sent me a new recruit! Ahhh, it's been too long... Ahem. I'm Brithael, forgemaster o' the Blacksmiths' Guild.

55.original: If yer aimin' to become a smitty worth the name, 'twould be my great pleasure to educate ye on the finer points o' the craft.

56.original: Oh, the rest o' these sour-faced bastards'll tell ye it's hard, gruelin' work fit only fer the best an' brightest, but I say put a hammer in the hands o' the willin' an' see what happens!

57.original: What d'ye say then, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>? Will ye swing a hammer fer ol' Brithael?

58.original: Swing a hammer for ol' Brithael?

61.original: Ha ha! I knew I liked ye the moment I set eyes on ye...er... What did ye say yer name was again?

62.original: <hex:022903EB0203>! A name fit fer a hero if ever I heard one! In fact, I reckon I <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> hear it in a bard's song once! ...Or was it that poor sod cursin' in his cups at the Wench?

63.original: Bah! Don't matter if it was savin' the world or <hex:020835E905FF176375636B6F6C64696E27207965722068757362616E64FF1962656464696E2720736F6D656F6E652773206D6F7468657203>─'tis time to forge yerself a new reputation, pound out a new legend! An' ye can trust ol' Brithael to help ye do it!

64.original: But there I go, puttin' the cart before the chocobo. Here, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>─take this cross-pein hammer. A smitty without a hammer is like me without a drink─bloody useless!

65.original: Well, don't jus' stand there gawpin' at her. Take her in yer hands, have a few practice swings, whatever ye fancy! She's all yours now.

66.original: Ah, what I wouldn't give to be you right now, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. A smitty never forgets his first hammer... <sniff>

67.original: Say it ain't so, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>! You an' me, we'd get on right as rain, we would! I beg ye reconsider...

68.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the tool received from this quest.

69.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

70.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
